comment_data.body:
Hi @blooddimmedtide @zeertzjq , I'd like to work on this. The cause is clear from the report: leftover_i is an int
assigned from a size_t, so it wraps negative at >= 2^31 and the padding check is skipped.

My plan is to replace the sentinel with a bool has_padding and run the padding validation
from src_i with a size_t loop index, which also removes the (int) cast. I'll also check the
rest of base64_decode and base64_encode for other narrowing of lengths or indices.

I'll open a PR shortly unless someone is already on it.

title: base64_decode: inputs over 2 GiB skip padding check and return uninitialized bytes
